data.description:
# Fix tree_coverage helper reading children from wrong JSON key

## Summary
The shared plan-skill helper _wl_show_children (skills/shared/tree_coverage.py) reads data['workItem']['children'], but `wl show <id> --children --json` returns the children list at the TOP level (data['children']), alongside 'workItem'. As a result run_coverage_review sees zero children and reports vacuous 100% coverage.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. _wl_show_children returns the top-level 'children' list from wl show --children --json.
2. run_coverage_review reports real child AC coverage (child_summary populated).
3. Existing tests for tree_coverage pass (updated if they encoded the wrong shape).

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Create a work item with children.
2. Run python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/home/rgardler/.pi/agent/skills/shared'); import tree_coverage as tc; print(tc._wl_show_children('<id>'))" — returns [] even though wl show --children --json returns the children.

## Notes
- discovered-from:AH-0MTFPDKDU006QUDC (plan run exposed the bug; workaround applied via monkeypatch).
- File: /home/rgardler/.pi/agent/skills/shared/tree_coverage.py (~line 145).
- Agent infrastructure (.pi/agent/skills) — do not edit without explicit authorisation.
data.title: Fix tree_coverage helper reading children from wrong JSON key

data.description:
While running the full vitest suite via the implement finish gate for AH-0MTFRQR42001M8WQ, one GymScout.test.ts test failed once (14 tests | 1 failed) while 30 full-suite runs (including three consecutive standalone GymScout.test.ts runs and two consecutive full-suite runs) all passed 526/526. The GymScout scene was not touched by the change. Likely a timing-sensitive assertion (Phaser scene tick / audio or animation timing) that flakes under parallel CPU load. Fix: make the assertion robust (e.g. use toBeGreaterThan with a tolerance, advance ticks deterministically, or increase the tick count) and verify with repeated full-suite runs. discovered-from:AH-0MTFPDKDU006QUDC

## Acceptance Criteria

1. GymSwarm.test.ts AC3 passes reliably: the swarm-hit poll must not depend on a single random-spread volley landing — the swarm re-fires aimed volleys until one hits (verified 10x standalone runs green).
2. GymTank.test.ts AC3 passes reliably: the formation-drift assertion must not depend on real-time wall-clock waits that vary under full-suite parallel CPU load (verified 10x standalone runs green).
3. The full project test suite (npm --silent test) passes consistently under parallel load: 3 consecutive full-suite runs green at the fix commit.
4. GymDiver.test.ts AC1 stays green (deterministic tick dt + polling, commit c2aaa54).
data.title: GymScout.test.ts is flaky under full-suite parallel load
